description: Run a Virtuous query-builder query against one record type (contacts, gifts, campaigns, projects, tasks, grants, pledges, recurring gifts, events ...). Conditions use parameter/operator names from virtuous_get_query_options. Returns { list, total }. For Contact and Gift, full_details returns full records instead of the abbreviated view. Virtuous: POST /api/<Resource>/Query.

full_details.description: Contact and Gift only: return full records (Query/FullContact, Query/FullGift).

groups.description: Condition groups, as in the Virtuous query builder. Omit for all records.

operator.description: An operator allowed for that parameter, from QueryOptions, e.g. "Is".

parameter.description: A parameter name from the QueryOptions tool, e.g. "Last Name".

secondaryValue.description: Second value, for range operators such as Between.

value.description: The value to compare against (if the operator needs one).

values.description: Several values, for operators that allow multiple values.

include_archived.description: Contact queries only: include archived contacts.

resource.description: Which Virtuous record type to query.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by (e.g. for gifts: Id, Amount, GiftDate, ReceiptDate, Batch).

name: virtuous_query
title: Query records
